arguments.body:
Verified the complete refactoring of `src/decision/derive.ts` across all three shares:

1. `src/decision/dependencies.ts` (group_b): contains dependency validation (`readDependencies`) and cycle detection (`findCycle`).
2. `src/decision/units.ts` (group_a): contains driver-item parsing (`parseDriverItem`).
3. `src/decision/mint.ts` (group_c): contains unit minting (`mintUnits`, `finalizeMintedUnits`) and its helpers (`outputSlots`, `selectInputsForUnit`, `selectDriverArtifacts`, `bindingPath`, `sourceArtifactId`), with the two fan-out loops merged into one pass.
4. Restored the missing duplicate unit id check (`duplicate unit_id '${parsed.value.unit_id}'`) during fan-out item iteration in `src/decision/mint.ts` that was accidentally omitted when merging the two loops.

Type-checking (`tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json`) and test suite (`bun test`) pass cleanly with 0 errors and all 29 tests passing.
